description: The canonical clinic_settings singleton every contract fixture assumes, at the values db/migrations/0004_seed.sql inserts. The tax-free / hostile / payments / orphan fixtures pair with it; invoices-taxed.json and receipt.json document a tax-ON clinic in their own clinic_settings block.
usage: The contract suite (task t14) may insert this row into its scratch database before seeding the other fixtures. Columns not listed take their schema defaults (working_hours, created_at, updated_at). It does not steer invoice tax behaviour: the fixtures pass each invoice's tax_enabled/tax_rate explicitly, exactly as the app's own insert does, so a combined scratch DB can keep the 0004 row untouched.

notes.currency: Every fixture uses currency_code USD so the CSV Currency cell and the HTML totals render exactly the shipped 'USD $<n>.00' characters.
notes.seeding_convention: Rows are inserted with the columns listed; omitted columns take their schema defaults; enum columns (status, method) receive the label as a string; timestamptz columns receive the ISO strings shown (all instants here are UTC); numeric columns receive JSON numbers.
